tei:div.tei:p: "$ (243)༄༅// dpal kyai rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dbang chog lung dang man ngag gi snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

(244)༄༅// na maḥshrī tsakra nā tha rat+na war+dhā ya// bde stong che las ma g.yos kyang*// ngo mtshar gzugs sku'i rnam 'phrul gyis// mtha' yas gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i// bla ma kyai li rdo rjer 'dud// de yi dkyil 'khor chen por// slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'i// cho ga'i mtshams sbyor brda sprod kyi// rnam dbye mdor bsdus bshad kyis nyon// sdom ni// phan yon nyes dmigs legs shes pa'i// mtshan ldan slob dpon slob ma yis// dus gnas dkyil 'khor nges byas te// nges tshig ldan pa'i cho ga rtsam// dpal kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba don du gnyer ba'i slob ma rnams khrus byas te/ phyag dang yon phul nas rgan rim bzhin 'khod pa la/ las kyi slob mas me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ slob dpon gyis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom bgyi snyam pas byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa rnams nas ji ltar byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la (245)yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang mthun par dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa las// 'dir theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa las kyang khyad chos bzhis khyad par du 'phags pa sngags kyi theg pa yin/ de la rgyud sde chen po bzhi las/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud yin/ de la'ang thabs kyi rgyud dang*/ shes rab kyi rgyud dang*/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud dang rnam pa gsum las/ 'di gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal kyai rdo rje'i rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud rnams kyi rjes su 'brang nas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bir wa pa'i zhal snga nas bkral ba'i snying po kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur bsgrub par bgyi/

de la spyir dbang bskur ba thob pa'i phan yon ni/ gang zag dbang po yang rab rnams dbang rjes de ma thag grol bar 'gyur la/ gang zag mchog ma yin pas kyang dbang nyid rtag tu goms par byas na lam gzhan ma bsgoms kyang skye ba (246)bdun nas mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par gsungs shing*/ dbang thob nas rtsa ba'i ltung bas ma gos na skye ba bcu drug nas 'grub par gsungs pa dang*/ dbang gis grol bar ma nus pa'i gang zag gzhan rnams la grol byed kyi lam ston pa'i snod rung du byed pa'i thabs kyang dbang nyid yin par gsungs pas na/ dbang bskur ba rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa bar grub pa'i phyir dang*/ dbang bskur bas tshe rabs mang po'i sdig pa 'dag cing dngos grub thams cad dbang bskur ba la brten nas 'byung bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung khungs su gyur pa'i dbang len pa la shin tu spro bar mdzod cig /de ltar dbang thob pa'i phan yon nges par byas nas phan yon can gyi dbang de ma thob pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ gal te dbang ma thob kyang lam la 'bad par byas na 'bras bu 'thob par 'gyur ram snyam na/ de lta bu ni sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa ma yin te/ dbang ma thob par rgyud 'chad pa dang bskyed rdzogs kyi don bsgoms kyang dngos grub mi thob cing*/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub phra mo tsam thob srid kyang phyi ma ngan song du 'gro bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// rdo rje theg pa'i lam la brten nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub par 'dod pa'i blo gros can dag gis dbang la shin tu gus par bya dgos pa yin/ de ltar thob na phan yon dang ma thob na nyes dmigs yod pa'i dbang de gang gis skur bar byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni mdor bsdu na/ sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag shes// cho ga'i las la rab tu mkhas// snying rjes slob ma rab 'dzin pa// dbang bskur ba yi slob dpon mchog

/ces gsungs pa ltar gyi (247)mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig cis kyang dgos pa yin// gang la bskur ba slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni// dad dang snying rjes sems rab dul// rnam rtog nyung zhing blo dang ldan// sngags kyi lam mchog don gnyer ba// mthun zhing grangs dang ldan pa bzung*// zhes pa ltar gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma nang gshin pa gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar grangs kha yar ba re phyag len la mdzad pa lags/ de ltar slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid nges par byas nas/ gang gi tshe bskur ba'i dus ni/ gza' skar dang sbyor byed bzang po 'dzom pa'i yar gyi ngo'am/ de rnams lhag par 'dzom na mar gyi ngo la'ang nyes pa med par bshad pa lags/ gang du dbang bskur ba'i gnas ni/ sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos skyong zhing phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med pa/ khyad par du rang ngam bla ma gong mas sa'i cho ga tshul bzhin du byas shing*/ snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos dben pa zhig cis kyang dgos pa lags// gang la brten nas dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ mtshon par bya ba nges don don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ snying po bde ba chen po len cing 'dzin par bshad la/ de nyid mtshon par byed pa'i drang don kun rdzob pa'i dkyil 'khor la grub chen so sos bkral ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam gzhag mang du bshad kyang*/ mdor bsdu na/ rdul tshon/ ras bris/ lus dkyil te gsum mam/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor te bzhi las/ deng sang gi gang zag phal cher smin byed du rung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni rdul tshon dang ras bris nyid gtso cher gsungs pa yin la/ gang zhig bskur ba dbang gi nges tshig ni/ gtor zhing blugs pa ste dbang bzhi po rim pa bzhin spyi bo dang*/ lce (248)dang*/ dbang gi gnas dang*/ rlung sems la gtor zhing blugs pa la brten nas/ sku bzhi'i myu gu 'byung bas na dbang zhes bya ba yin/ ji ltar bskur ba'i cho ga la lam la sbyor bas byed pa rgyu'i dbang*/

kun nas goms par byed pa lam gyi dbang*/ mi 'phrog pa la sbyor bar byed pa 'bras bu'i dbang ste/ gnas skabs kyi sgo nas gsum du gsungs kyang*/ gang zag gi sgo nas du ma zhig tu 'gyur ba las/ 'dir smin byed kyi cho ga dang mthun par 'chad pa lags/ de bas na rgyud sde'i dgongs pa grub pa'i bla ma brgyud pa las rim par 'ongs pa'i nyams len gyi rim pa la dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa bdun nam brgyad dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du mngon par dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang*/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi gnyis kyi sgo nas ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i tshul gnyis las/ rdul tshon ltar na bzhi pa sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga'am/ ras bris ltar na nub dang po sta gon gyi skabs su babs pa yin/ de la sa'i lha mo sta gon dang*/ lha dang bum pa lhag gnas te/ lhag gnas dang po gsum kho bos bgyis zin nas/ slob ma lhag gnas la/ lus kyi bya ba nges 'byung bskyed// nang dbang bskur la khyad don zhu// spro ba bskyed de rgyun bshags bya// bsrung ba byas te mchod pas mchod// so shing dor la khyor chu blud// srung skud btags te ku sha sbyin// zab mo'i chos bshad rmi lam brtag /ces pa ltar bcu bzhi las/ lus kyi bya ba ni bus byas phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul nas rang rang gi gral la snyims pa me tog dang bcas pas gus pa'i sgo nas 'khod du gzhug ces 'byung bas/ slob dpon la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo kyi rdo rje dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i (249)mos gus dang ldan pas slob ma sta gon gyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas myang 'das kyi bsam pa brtan por bskyed du gzhug pa ni/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya// bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan// bdag gzhan 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// dad pa chen po ldan pa dag

/blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste// 'di yi 'bras bu gnyer mi bya// gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na// 'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// ces gsungs te/ sngags kyi dngos grub rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ye shes don du gnyer ba dag dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par bya'i/ tshe 'di'i bde skyid dang phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang dang*/ rang don du nyan rang gi byang chub 'dod pa rnams ni ma yin te/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa la ma ltos par thabs dman pa gzhan la brten nas bsgrub tu yod pa'i phyir ro// de bas na bdag gzhan thams cad srid zhi'i pha rol tu son pa'i mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa don du gnyer ba'i dad pa can blo gros dang ldan pa dag dkyil 'khor chen por gzhug par bya ste/ tshe 'di'i bde 'bras don du gnyer bas zhugs na pha rol gyi don mi 'grub cing*/ gzhan don du mi gnas par mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas la dmigs te zhugs na rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don bde blag tu 'grub pa yin/ de ltar nges par byas nas bsam pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khams gsum 'khor ba gang du gnas kyang sdug bsngal dang skyon dang nyes dmigs kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa yin te/ de rnams la sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa ji lta bu yod na/ (250)dmyal ba pa rnams la tsha grang gi sdug bsngal/ yi dwags rnams la bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal/ dud 'gro rnams la gcig la gcig za ba dang gsod pa dang bkol spyod kyi sdug bsngal/ mi rnams la 'dod pa btsal bas ma rnyed pa dang*/ mi 'dod pa thog tu bab pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha ma yin rnams la 'thab rtsod dang lus bcad cing dral ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal/ lha rnams la 'chi 'pho ba dang*/ gong ma nas 'og mar lhung lhung ba dang*/ mthar ngan song du skye bar shes pa na/ dmyal ba'i lus kyi sdug bsngal las kyang ches che ba'i sems kyi sdug bsngal yod par bshad/

'o na sdug bsngal de las rang nyid gcig pu thar pa'i nyan rang gi byang chub thob par bya dgos pa yin nam snyam na/ nyan rang gi byang chub ni rang don du spangs rtogs kyi yon tan ma rdzogs shing*/ gzhan don gyi phrin las rgya chen po mi 'byung*/ mthar 'tshang rgya ba la yun ring du byed pas blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis don du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu ma yin/ 'o na ci zhig don du gnyer bya yin na/ shes rab chen pos 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pas khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal las 'das shing*/ snying rje chen pos mya ngan las 'das pa'i mtha' la mi gnas pas sems can gyi don rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya dgos shing*/ de'ang rang nyid gcig pu'i don du ma yin te/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa bzhin du sems can la mtha' med/ mtha' med pa'i sems can re res kyang bdag gi pha ma byas shing*/ byas res kyis gnod pa mtha' dag las bskyabs shing*/ phan pa tshad med pa btags pa'i drin can sha stag yin pa la/ 'di rnams 'dod pa ni bde ba 'dod (251)kyang thabs la mi mkhas pa'i dbang gis la la ni sdug bsngal dngos la longs spyad// la la ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la longs spyod/ ma rig pa'i ling tog gis ni ldongs/ thar pa'i rten gyi 'khar ba dang ni bral// dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi dmigs bus ni ma zin/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam nas brdeg 'chos shing*/ ngan song gsum gyi g.yang sar 'grims pa 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du mos pa mdzod/ snying rje'o byas nas bzhag pas mi phan pas/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral bde ba la 'god dgos/ de'i nus pa da lta bdag la med/ bdag las lhag pa'i tshangs pa dang brgya byin dang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la sogs pa la'ang med/ su la yod na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kho na la yod pas/

bdag gis ma rgan sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ci nas kyang thob par bya/ de yang rgyu med rkyen med las mi thob pas rgyu rkyen gtso bo rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba dbang bskur ba legs par blangs te dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom bgyis shing lam la ci nus su 'bad par bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dud pa zhig bskyed 'tshal/ bsam pa de lta bus kun nas bslangs pa'i sgo gsum gyi dge ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur zhing*/ tshe 'di'i bde 'bras dang*/ phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang la sogs pa zhar 'byung gi tshul gyis 'grub pa yin te/ dper na 'bras dkar mo lo legs na rtswa dang phub ma zhar las 'byung ba dang 'dra ba lags/ nang gi dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dpal kyai rdo rje yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog (252)ma mang po nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de nyid la dmigs te slob dpon gyis hūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rnams slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs// thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis slar yang sbyangs nas/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de lha mo'i pad+mar babs pa khyed rnams skad cig gis dpal he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can re rer gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs sku'i dbyibs brgyud de/ lha mo'i pad+mar babs pa khyed rnams he ru kar gsal ba'i spyi bo nas thim pas dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa 'dres pa lhan gcig tu byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros slob dpon gyis hūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis yum gyi dku g.yon pa nas 'thon te rang rang gi gral la 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/

de ltar byas pa'i dgos pa ni dbang gi dngos gzhi ma thob kyi bar gyi gsang pa'i chos rnams nyan pa'i snod rung du bya ba dang*/ de dag gi skabs su slob dpon la'ang gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir du bsgrubs pa lags/ khyad par can gyi don zhu ba ni/ slob dpon kyai rdo rje yab yum dang gnyis su med par bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa stsal du gsol snyam pas snyims pa me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bdag med ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni (253)dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab ste/ de'i don ni/ slob dpon la dga' chen zhes bos nas/ byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de bdag la 'tshal ba'i slad du dam tshig ste sngags kyi sdom pa dang*/ de'i rten du thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyun bshags las thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/ de'i rten du rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang bcas pa'i so sor thar pa'i sdom pa stsal ba'i sgo nas thar pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi grong khyer du gzhug tu gsol zhes pa lags/ de ltar khyad par can gyi lam rdo rje theg pa la don gnyer gyi blo skyes pa de nyid shin tu legs pa yin no// zhes shes pa'i phyir du spro ba bskyed pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/

bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir zhugs pa kun// de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi// cho ga zab mo 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// drag po chen po bdud kyi sde// stobs chen dag kyang des bcom ste// 'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /(254)ces gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ khyed rang rnams cho ga'i sgo nas bur byas zin pa de la bu zhes nye ba'i tshig gis bos te/ khyed rnams theg chen gyi chos kyi snod yin la/ theg chen la'ang pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa gnyis las/ mchog tu gyur pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa de khyod la bstan par bya ste/ rdo rje theg pa 'di ni spyir dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin cing*/ khyad par du yang 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol tu sngags kyi lam la brten nas bdud btul zhing sangs rgyas su zin kyang*/ 'jig rten pa rnams drang ba'i phyir du slar yang mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul gyis 'dzam bu'i gling du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas rtag par zhen pa bzlog pa'i phyir du mya ngan las 'da' bar bstan pa yin no// de bas na dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam rdo rje theg pa dang mjal ba 'di shin tu skal ba bzang ba yin pas kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang chen po thob par bya ba'i phyir chos kyi bur gyur pa khyed rnams sngags kyi theg pa las blo gzhan du mi 'gyur ba gyis shig ces pa'i don lags/

rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar du bzhugs pa'i mos pa byas/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod nas tshe thog ma med pa nas (255)bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi spyan sngar stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin bshags par bgyi'o snyam pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kun gyi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba la dga' zhing rjes su yi rang snyam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi nye bar bsten pa'i don dam byang chub kyi sems stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can de bdag gis kyang bsgom par bgyi'o snyam du yid dam bca' ba dang*/ yul thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro snyam pa dang*/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa smon pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ de'i ched du theg pa'i thabs tshul rnams la rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi'o snyam pa 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can dang de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog cig snyam pa yongs su bsngo ba ste/ don de rnams yid la dran pa dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te thun mong ma yin pa'i yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub (256)spyod mchog yid 'ong dpyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces pa'i rgyun bshags lan gsum byas pa la brten nas thun mong ma yin pa'i so thar dang byang sems kyi sdom pa sngar ma thob pa gsar du thob cing thob zin yar 'phel du byed la/ nyams na sor chud par byed pa yin no// de ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed pa la bar chad ma 'byung ba'i phyir du bsrung bar bya ba ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rnams kyi lus la phog pas/ sdig pa dang gdon bgegs thams cad sregs shing sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ces dang*/ rdo rje gsor zhing*/ oṃ āṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ piṅga lor+dhake sha warta ma ne/ tsa turbing+sha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhu dzā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ kā pā lā mā lā nai kā dhā ri ṇā+e/ a dh+yāt+ma krūr tsit+tā ya/ daṃṣ+ṭī ṇi/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya gardza ya/ tardzā ya tardzā ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rā na/ bhan+ha bhan+dha/ nā gāṣ+ṭa kān/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sha trū na/ ha hā hi hī hu hū he hai ho hau haṃ haṃḥphaṭa swā hāḥ/ zhes bzlas pas bar chad bsrungs te/ slob dpon gyis dri'i chu rdo rje dang bcas pas khyed rnams kyi gnas gsum du reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams he ru kar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma āḥs mtshan pa las gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las thugs rdo rje ma rnams lam gyis byung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang mas yar reg ste/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ zhes brjod pas gsal btab cing*/ yas mar reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas brtan par byas (257)pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byas pas khyed rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gdod ma nas rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor gnas pa de cho ga 'dis ngo 'phrod cing gsal bar byas pa yin/ de ltar sems bskyed pa dang sgo gsum lhar byas ma thag pa de mchod pa'i yul du bzang ba yin pas/ me tog dbu la phul nas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ bdug spos shangs la/ dhū pe/ mar me spyan lam du/ a lo ke /thugs kar dri'i byug pa/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas ljags la/ nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod pa ni lus ngag yid gsum lhar shes pa'i sgo nas 'dod yon la ma chags par longs spyod ces pa'i don yin/ de ltar 'gal rkyen bar chad bsrungs te lhar bskyed cing mchod nas mthun rkyen dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa la thog mar so shing la brten nas brtag pa ni/

so shing rtsa sngags kyis mngon par bsngags la/ swa bhā was sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i so shing sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor me tog gi cod pan dang bcas pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid khyed rnams kyi phyag thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag pa'i slad du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥdzi hwa badz+ra saṃ warta ni swā hā/ zhes pas byin pa'i so shing de rgyu rin po che gser ram dngul las grub par mos te/ so drud pa bzhin byas pas rtse mo'i me tog las 'od zer byung ba zhal nas brgyud de khong par song bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang dbang gi ye shes skye ba la gegs byed kyi sgrib pa thams cad sman pa mkhas pas skyug (258)sman btang ba bzhin skyugs par mos te/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa haṃ/ zhes gsung zhing thal mo kha phye ste so shing gi ra bar ltos pa med par dor cig ces brjod la/ so shing gi ra ba khru gang gru bzhir dri bzang gis byug pa la tshom bu dgu bkod par dor te/ rtse mo bdag nyid la phyogs na mchog grub/ steng du mkha' spyod/ 'og tu sa spyod/ shar du zhi ba/ lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du rgyas pa/ mtshams rnams su bum pa bzang po la sogs pa'i dngos grub phran tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro// de ni rnal 'byor chen po'i bum dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ so shing gis kha dang so la sogs pa lus gtso che ba'i dri ma sbyong ba bzhin bum dbang gis kyang gtso bor lus kyi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa la shas/ rmi lam gsal por 'byung ba dang ngag gi dri ma sbyong byed khyor chu blud pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya/ sarba bi kalpā na a pa na ya hūm̐/

zhes pas lan gsum sbyin la/ de ni gsang dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ khyor chus ngag gi dri ma sbyong ba bzhin gsang dbang gis kyang ngag gi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa lags/ rmi lam du bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir du srung skud sbyin pa ni/ hūm̐ bzlas shing rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum btab ba'i srang bu gong ltar bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi lus tshad dang mnyam pa sum bsgril du byas pa rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum gyis btab pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi bar chad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sta gon gyi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu'i tshogs spyan drangs te dam tshig srad bu la thim zhes dang*/ srung skud thal mo'i bar du bzung la rtsa sngags bzla/ zhes pas byin gyis (259)brlabs pa de skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas la nyis skor du bcing ste/ zhes brjod cing phyag len ltar bcing*/ bum chu gtor zhing gur nas 'byung ba'i yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya'o// de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi snod rung du byed pa'i thabs yin te/ srung skud 'dogs pa shes rab ye shes kyi sbyang gzhi khams kyi bar chad bsrung ba'i ched du yin pa bzhin/ shes rab ye shes kyang khams bdud rtsi la bskur pa lags/ rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa dang mal stan lhag par gnas pa'i phyir du ku sha sbyin pa ni/ ku sha'i chun po che chung gnyis gong bzhin bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dhīḥlas byung ba'i ku sha che chung rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ dhīḥbazlas pa'i ku sha chung ba phyag g.yas dang*/ ha bzlas pa'i che ba g.yon du sbyin te/

de'i don ku sha dag byed kyi rdzas bla na med pa yin pa ltar/ dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes kyang mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'dag par byed pas ku sha sbyin pa dbang bzhi pa'i sngon 'gro lags shing*/ sngon byung bcom ldan 'das ku sha ma 'khrugs pa'i stan la bzhugs nas sangs rgyas pa bzhin ku sha'i stan la nyal te/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu mngon du byas nas sangs rgyas pa'i rten 'brel lam du byed pa lags/ chos zab mo bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum+bā ra'i me tog ltar/ brgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gi sems can mnyam med don// bla med byed par nus pa yin// bskal (260)pa bye ba du mar na// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na// sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro 'di yis gcod par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyi// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du// sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams 'dir ni dong bas na// rang byung skal ba chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ 'jig rten na u dum+bā ra'i me tog dkon pa ltar sangs rgyas dkon te/

sangs rgyas gcig 'jig rten du 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston pa na/ de dang khad nye ba'i sa phyogs shig tu u dum+bā ra'i me tog gcig 'byung de yang rgyal rigs las 'byung na dkar po dang*/ bram ze'i rigs las 'byung na ser por 'khrungs la/ sangs rgyas de lhums su zhugs pa na me tog de kha 'bus/ bltams pa na kha bye/ gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad pa na rgyas/ dka' thub mdzad pa na cung zad rnying*/ 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston pa na rgyas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na shin tu rgyas/ mya ngan la 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa na skam nas 'gro ste/ des na de de gnyis dkon mtshungs yin pas sangs rgyas (261)'jig rten du 'byon pa dkon/ byon nas chos gsungs pa dkon/ chos kyi nang nas theg pa chen po gsungs pa dkon/ theg chen gyi nang nas kyang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gsungs pa ni shin tu dkon/ dkon pas ci phan/ ri bong gi rwa dang nam mkha'i me tog kyang dkon no snyam na de dag dang mi mtshungs par dkon la phan yon chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ bskal pa bye ba du ma nas bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams dkyil 'khor chen po mthong ba'i mod la 'dag par 'gyur na/ dbang blangs te dam tshig dang sdom pa la nan tan du byas nas sngags kyi spyod pa yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa'i thabs nyams su len pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod la brtson pa'i sgo nas lam 'di la blo brtan par byas na ngan 'gro dang srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgyun gcod par 'gyur ba dang*/ de bas na khyed rnams kyi rnyed pa'i mchog legs par rnyed cing*/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus pas yongs su bzung ste de'i rigs su skye bzhin par 'byung bas na/ theg chen gyi lam mchog tu gyur pa 'di la brten nas myur tu 'jig rten gyi gnas lugs mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur bar gdon mi za bas don de la dga' ba khyad par can dang ldan par mdzod cig

/ ces 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed nas/ rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung bar bya ba ni// bu kyes nga ni dkyil 'khor dang*// mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang*// rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa// de kun nga la drang por smros// zhes bshad pas/ rang gi sgrub pa'i khang par bde ba'i mal zhig bcas te/ slob dpon gyis gnang ba'i ku sha chung ba sngas dang*/ che bstan du bting*/ gos dri ma med pa gyon/ glo g.yas pa 'og (262)tu phab nas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyal te sems dug gsum gyi rnam rtog thams cad rgyang ring du byas/ lha dang bla ma yid la dran bzhin pas sang nyin yi dam lha'i dkyil 'khor mthong bar 'gyur ro snyam pa'i dga' spro dung nge ba'i sgo nas dran shes bzhin dang ldan par nyal na lung ston pa'i rmi lam 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de yang rmi lam bzang ba'i ltas ni/ rmi lam sangs rgyas mthong na ni// yon tan rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin// mchod rten dang ni sku gzugs mthong*// de la mchod pa brtsoms pa dang*// dge slong dag la chos nyan tam// yang na mi nyan na yang rung*// chos ni rnam par spyod pa dang*// de bzhin mdo sde rnam par spyod// ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang mchod rten mthong ba/ dam pa'i chos kyi glegs bam thogs pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde'i dbus su bzhugs pa/ rang gi bla ma las chos nyan pa/ nyi zla shar ba/ rgyal por dbang bskur ba/ rta dang glang por zhon pa/ nyi phug dag tu nyi ma lde ba/ dge slong dag dang chos kyi 'bel gtam byed pa/ zas bzang po ro brgya dang ldan pa thob pa dang*/ 'bru'i bang mdzod la sogs pa'i gter rnyed pa dang*/ skye bo mang pos bdag la 'dud bstod byed pa dang*/ skye bo mang po la bdag nyid kyis chos bshad pa/ pha ma dang bla ma dang mdza' bshes dang phrad pa/ gos rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa la sogs pa rmis na rmi lam bzang ba yin pas sngags kyi dngos grub rab 'bring tha ma gsum gang rung 'grub par shes par byas nas zhen pa med pa'i dga' ba bsgom zhing dga' ston bya/

gal te ngan pa'ang 'byung srid de/ de'i ltas ni/ rgya skyegs kyi ri la 'dzegs pa dang*/ ka ra wī ra'i me tog rgyas pa 'thu ba/ (263)mchod sdong dang bye ma dang thal phung la 'dzegs pa/ spre'u dang bong bu la zhon nas kha phyir phyogs te 'gro ba/ phag dang rnga mo dang ma he la zhon pa/ bud med nag mo gos nag can la 'dod log spyod pa/ g.yang sa dang*/ gcong rong du zhugs pa/ ri dang shing las lhung ba/ khyi dang khwa dang srin pos zos pa/ mi nag po lcags kyi dbyug pa can gyis bsdigs pa/ skra bregs pa/ lus la til mar gyis byugs pa/ phreng ba dmar pos thod bcings pa la sogs pa byung na cung zad ngan pa yin pas gnyid sad ma thag tu chos thams cad rmi lam gyi snang ba dang khyad med de/ don ma grub pa cung zad kyang med snyam du bden med kyis sbyangs pas rgyas 'debs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi rnal 'byor bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag las byung ba bzhin lung blangs te nyams su len pa dang*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg blugs pa la sogs pa rmi lam ngan pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i thabs la brtson par bya dgos pa yin/ de rnams kyis slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub zin nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sang nyin 'byung ba lags zhes brjod do// dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba'i brda sprod pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i dbang bskur ba gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa'ang rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la rang re rnams kyis rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus rnyed/

mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi (264)bstan pa dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blang du yod pa'i skabs 'dir dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa re byed dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan don dam par sems can thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po can yin na'ang gnas skabs su glo bur gyi dri ma sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma spangs kyi bar la rgyun chad med par sdug bsngal gyi khor mo yug tu gyur pa'i 'khor bar skye zhing*/ 'khor ba'i skye gnas gang du skyes kyang bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal me 'obs bzhin las ma 'das pa yin/ sdug bsngal can gyi sems can de rnams kyis pha ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med pas 'di rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag pa'i slad du tshe 'di'i bya ba snying po med pa thams cad spangs te dmigs pa tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po dang*/ shes rab chen po zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can gyi dpal kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par bya dgos/ de'i ched du bden gnyis zung 'jug tu rtogs pa'i lta bas rgyud sbyangs nas bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa bum pa'i dbang bskur ba dang rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang bar byed pa dbang gong ma gsum mtha' rten dang bcas pa blangs la nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa dung pa re bskyed mdzod/ de la sta gon du gnas pa yan chad grub zin nas/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga la bri zhing rgyan dgram pa/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ mjug gi cho ga ste rnam pa bzhi yod pa las/ bri ba la'ang*/ thig gis bri ba/ tshon gyis bri ba/ mtshan ma dgod pa/ rgyan dgram pa ste bzhi dang*/ sgrub cing mchod pa la bdag bskyed sngon du song ba'i sgo nas dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor 'byin pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa dang*/ skye mched (265)sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa dang*/

ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa dang*/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas btab pa'i tshul gyis sgrub pa ste rnam pa bzhis bsgrub nas nang du dkyil 'khor pa mchod pas mnyes par bya ba dang*/ phyi rol tu 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gtor mas tshims par bya ba rnams dgos te/ kho bos sngon du legs par grub zin pa yin

zhes brda sprad/ ras bris ltar na/ gong gi dngos gzhi'i cho ga la zhes pa'i sngon du/ bdag bskyed sngon du song ba'i zhes pa nas/ legs par grub zin pa yin ces pa'i bar gyis chog / 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/ slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i dbang thams cad bdag 'jug gi tshul du len pa ste/ de dag kyang sngon du legs par grub cing*/ de'i rjes su phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro mnyes par bya ba'i phyir du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma dbul ba dang*/ slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir du dam tshig gsum gyis glu blangs shing*/ de kho na nyid kyi bden pa bsgrags pa rnams grub par byas pa lags/ da khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la lha dang skal pa mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga dang*/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba'i cho ga gnyis yod pa las/ 'jug pa la maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba gdab// sdom pa bsgrags bzung gnyis ka bya// gdong bcings me tog phreng ba gtad// 'khyil pas bsangs shing dris lan bya// nang gi (266)sems bskyed gsang bar gdams// yol ba'i nang 'jug dam la bzhag /ye shes dbab ste gsol ba gdab// kha dog dris lan bstod pa bya// me tog phul te mig ras phye// dkyil 'khor bstan pa 'jug pa'o// zhes pa ltar las/ thog mar slob dpon la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal kyai rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bdag med ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pa'i sgo nas don du gnyer bya'i gtso bo dam tshig de nyid ces pa'i dam tshig thob par byed pa la khas blangs dang cho ga'i sgo nas thob par bya ba gnyis yod pa las/

khas blangs kyi sgo nas thob par bya ba la 'dzin rgyu'i dam tshig ngo shes par bya ba'i ched du sdom pa bsgrags pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// blo chen khyod kyis gzung bya ste// byang chub sems gang de rdo rje// shes rab (267)dril bu zhes su bshad// slob dpon khyed kyis gzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa dam tshig yin par gsungs// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos khyod kyis gzung bar bya// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus byos// de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni// phas pham par ni rab tu bshad// spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste// rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya// gal te nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa// kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur// khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya// ma byin par yang mi blang ngo*// 'dod la log par mi spyad cing*// brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o// phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi// chang ni rnam par spang bar bya// sems can don phyir ma gtogs pa// bya ba ma yin thams cad spangs// dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing*// rnal 'byor pa kun bsnyen bkur bya// lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang*// ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang*// yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni// ci nus par ni rjes su bskyang*// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// sems can don la rgyab phyogs min// 'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spangs// rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags// lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya zhing*// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma (268)'gom par mi bya'o// 'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad// khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya// rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni// gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu grags// zhes gsungs te/

de'i don ni sangs rgyas te rnam snang gi dam tshig tu phyi nang gsang ba'i dkon mchog gsum skyabs gnas su 'dzin pa yin te/ rnam snang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku yin pas yon tan gyi rten byed pa ltar skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i sdom pas kyang sdom pa thams cad kyi rten byed pa'i phyir ro// rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig ni phyi nang gsang ba'i rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya slob dpon rnams 'dzin pa ste/ mi bskyod pa thugs rdo rje byang chub sems kyi ngo bo yin pa ltar dam tshig gsum dang slob dpon yang byang chub kyi sems kyis 'dzin pas so// rin chen te rin 'byung gi dam tshig ni/ zang zing mi 'jigs chos byams pa'i sbyin pa rnams nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum ste dus drug tu btang ba'am/ dngos su mi nus na 'dun pa dang ma bral bar bya ba ste/ rin 'byung sbyin pa'i ngo bo ser sna rnam par dag pa yin pa ltar/ sbyin pa'ang dbul po 'dor bar byed pa dang ser sna'i gnyen po yin pas so// pad+ma ste 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig ni phyi bya spyod nang rnal 'byor gsang ba rnal 'byor bla med de rgyud sde bzhi dang*/ nyan thos rang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' ste theg pa gsum dang bcas pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dzin par dam bca' ba ste/ 'od dpag med shes rab kyi ngo bo gsung rnam par dag pa yin pa ltar/ chos kyang shes rab kyis 'dzin cing gsung gis ston par byed pa'o// las kyi rigs te don yod grub pa'i dam tshig ni sdom pa thams cad 'dzin pa dang mchod pa'i las la brtson par bya ba yin te/ don yod grub pa brtson 'grus kyi ngo bo phrin las kyi (269)rang bzhin yin pa ltar/ dge ba la spyod pa'i brtson 'grus kyi sdom pa 'dzin pa dang*/ sangs rgyas la mchod pa byed pa gnyis ka'ang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rjes su skyong ba yin pas so// de rnams kyis rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig bsgrags nas/

rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig bsgrags pa la tshul khrims gsum spyir bshad pa dang*/ so sor bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni// zhes sogs sh+lo ka gnyis te/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las bshad pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rgyal po la 'byung ba'i ltung ba gcig /blon po la 'byung ba gcig /rgyal blon thun mong du 'byung ba bzhi/ byang sems las dang po pa la 'byung ba'i brgyad de bcu bzhi po 'dir yang bsrung dgos par ston pa lags/ gnyis pa so sor bshad pa la/ nyes spyod sdom pa// dge ba chos sdud/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum las// dang po ni/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya// zhes sogs sh+lo ka gnyis te/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi so thar rigs bdun gang rung yin pas rang rang gi cho ga las thob pa'am/ des ma thob na sta gon dang 'jug pa'i skabs su yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang na mnyam pa'i so thar gyi sdom pa thob pas na de'i bslab bya rtsa bzhi chang dang lnga po gzhan don du 'gyur na ma gtogs spang dgos par ston pa lags/ dge ba chos sdud ni/ dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing*// zhes sogs rkang pa drug ste dge ba spyod pa'i grogs skyes bu dam pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa rnams la brten nas dge ba bcu spyod pa ste/ bcu po der pha rol tu phyin pa'i nyams len thams (270)cad 'dus pas so// sems can don byed ni/ theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig ste/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i mi mthun phyogs rnams spangs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don bsgrub dgos par ston pa yin/ de dag mdor bsdus te bsgrags pa ni/ lha dang lha min zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig ste/ gzhan la gnod pa dang*/ gzhan ma dad par 'gyur ba'i spyod pa rnams spong ba dang*/ so thar byang sems gnyis su ma zad gsang ba spyi rgyud sogs rgyud sde 'og ma nas bshad pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang bsrung dgos par ston pa ste/

rgyud sde gong ma'i sdom pa'i nang du 'og ma'i sdom pa'ang 'du bas so// de ltar bshad pa'i don de dag yid la dran pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ ces sogs kyis brda' sprad la sta gon gyi skabs dkon mchog sogs nas 'grub par shog /ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas rigs lnga spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig rnams kyang 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa ni// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs (271)mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces pas dam tshig dang sdom pa 'dzin par khas blangs nas/

'dzin rgyu'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i gtso bo dbang bskur ba las skye bar 'gyur zhing*/ dbang bskur ba'ang dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa sngon du 'gro ba can yin pas sngon chad kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang bskur nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po res gdong bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wā ri hūm̐ zhes pas gdong bcing nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi btub pas phyag rten gyi slad du me tog rigs lnga brgyus pa'i phreng ba re byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ sogs kyis sbyin/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ las bum gyi chu gtor la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha (272)na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bar du gcod pa bsrungs nas/ rigs nges par bya ba'i slad du/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dris pa'i lan btab pa'i mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// des bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes dris pa'i lan btab pa'i mos pa mdzad nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig 'dod pa des// gsang sngags nang gi sems bskyed pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sems can thams cad la phan pa bla na med pa bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam pa'i kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dung pa zhig bskyed/ de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par langs pa las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa nya gang ba lta bu zhig lam gyis byung ba'i mos pa mdzod// chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba bde stong nam mkha' lta bu'o snyam du yid la byas te/

de nyid gzugs kyi rnam par langs pa las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa zhig gsal lam gyis byung bar mos te/ de gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa de snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya stāṃ hoḥsidh+ya badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes pas sems bskyed pa rnams phyi 'jug gi gtso bo yin pas brda don 'phrod pa gal che ba lags// de ltar sems bskyed pa dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun tu spyod pa rnams snod dang mi ldan pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi btub bo zhes (273)gsang bar gdams pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su rab tu zhugs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes pas gsang bar gdams pa rnams phyi'i 'jug pa yin/ nang 'jug gi slad du khyed rang rnams slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas zhugs pa'i mos pa byas te dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la dbu dud pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ zhes sam/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gang mos brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i sgo nang du 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ nang gi 'jug pa la sngon 'gro dam la bzhag pa bzhi'i dang po phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya'i// khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re zhes dang nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/
he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs//

zhes dang*/ 'di'ang nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa yin te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na khyod kyi mgo bo 'gem par 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ mna' chu sbyin pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu dung chos su (274)blugs pa sbyin la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha zhes dang*/ bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// nga la yang brnyas pa ma byed cig /byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung bar 'gyur ta re zhes pa rnams sngon 'gro dam la bzhag pa yin// nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang rnams lus tsog pu gang la yang ma snyes par me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar te sems gzhan tu ma yengs par mdzad nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ chos thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan nam sgyu ma lta bur shes par byas te/ de'i ngang las khyed rang rnams he ru kar gsal ba'i rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs ba lta bu chang zung thur du bstan/ mchog ma gnyis gyen du bstan pa la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du rkang pa gnyis bgrad nas gnas pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhaiṃ ljang gu drag cing bzod par dka' ba rkang pa'i bar du raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/

snying gar laṃ las byung (275)ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i lte ba la hūm̐/ mgrin par waṃ las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa la as mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba 'khrigs pa lta bu la has mtshan pa/ slob dpon la rdo rje sems dpa' dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rang gi rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rlung g.yos te sum mdor me sbar/ rkang mthil gyi dzhaiṃ mer 'bar ba long bu gnyis nas zhugs sum mdo'i gnas su 'dzom ste drag tu 'bar bas snying ga'i sa bsros/ des mgrin pa'i chu bskol ba'i zeg ma snying ga'i sa'i steng du bab/ de nas rkang 'og gi rlung gis gyen la btegs/ spyi bo'i rlung gis thur la mnan pa'i bar snang du yed yed yod par gyur/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kha ba chen po bab pa bzhin du khyed rang rnams kyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje dril bu dkrol te/ hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ zhes dang*/ ā we sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya/ tsa la ya/ hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ zhes mang du brjod cing spos rol bya/ rgyu dbang gi tshe spogs pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bla ma dam pa sku dar la bab pa phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa gcig bsgom ste/ de la mos gus drag tu byas pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ rtsa sngags mang du brjod cing spos dang rol mo bya/ de ltar ye shes phab pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag ste brtan (276)par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes pas brtan par byas nas/ phebs pa'i rtags ni sku babs na nam mkha' la gar byed/ gsung babs na saṃskṛ ta'i skad smra/ thugs babs na dus gsum shes pa la sogs pa 'byung bar 'gyur bas de nyid ngo shes par byas nas lam du srol bar gyis shig /de ltar ye shes phebs pa de lhag pa'i lha dang ngo sprod pa'i slad du dkyil 'khor la gsol ba 'debs pa slob dpon gyis bgyi bar gda' ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*// bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog / lan gsum dang*/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i ched du khyed rang rnams mig ras dang bcas bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi thad kyi bar snang la bltas te mig gi lam du kha dog gang mthong ba zhig nged la smra dgos pas/ kye khyed kyi mig lam na ci snang*/ zhes dris la/ dkar po mthong na zhi ba/ ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang*/ sngon po'am nag po mngon spyod/ ljang gu'am sna tshogs sam khra bo mthong na las sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes pas dngos grub kyi mtshan ltas brtag nas/ slob dpon gyis lha thams cad gdan gsum tshang ba'i rang bzhin du shes pa'i sgo nas bstod pa ni/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod// ser sna rdo rje bdag la stsol// 'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs// yid dang phrag dog chen po kun// rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mchog /las rnams (277)thams cad sgrub byed pa// rdo rje can kun bdag dgyes mdzod// ces pas bstod/ de nas dkyil 'khor la me tog dbul ba ni/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das dpal kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/

de'ang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig nyid gdul bya 'dul ba'i ched du gtso 'khor gyi rnam pa can du bstan pa tsam ma gtogs ngo bo la bzang ngan gcig kyang med mod/ 'on kyang rang gi las bsags pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog cig snyam pa'i blos/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes gsung zhing 'bul ba'i tshul mdzod cig / ces bsgom la phul te gang la lhung ba las nye ba de'i rigs su nges par byas la me tog de slob dpon gyis blangs te/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes lha la bos nas des kyang me tog gi phreng ba slar sbyin par bsams la/ me tog slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag mig ras bsal te/ /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur pa// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ zhes pa ni/ kye rdo rje ltos shig ces bskul ba yin pas// dkyil 'khor legs par gzigs shig / ces bsgo/ /slar yang dkyil 'khor lta bar bskul ba ni// thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che// me tog gang du lhung gyur pa// de ni khyod kyi he ru ka /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// dam tshig thams cad bskyangs pa dang*// sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis// zhes brjod la/ de'ang 'di na dpal kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs te/ phyi rol rdo rje'i (278)rwa ba gur me ri dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dur khrod brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad/ shing gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ steng gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu brgyad/

shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad// mchod rten brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ro dang ro langs la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i nang du chos 'byung gi nang du tshud pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang*/ 'phan dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ (279)phreng ba dang*/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha rnams/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i dbus su sdong bu dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tshangs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i gdan dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du shar du tshangs pa ser po/

lhor dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor nor bdag ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po/ nub byang du thag zangs ris dud ka rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas pa rnams ni rten gzhal yas khang pa yin la/ brten pa lha ni shar du gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug /g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas cang te'u/ g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu be tā lī ser mo g.yas rus sbal/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang gu g.yas sbrul/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puk+ka sī sngon mo g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong*/ g.yon gsil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngo dmar g.yas 'khor lo// g.yon thong gshol 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa ste lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ (280)rtsa ba'i zhal sngon po/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud ka zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas kyi dang po na glang po che dkar po/ g.yon gyi dang po na sa'i lha ser po/ de gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na rta sngon po/ gsum pa na bong bu gwa pa/ bzhi pa na glang ser po/ lnga pa na rnga mong thal ka /drug pa na mi dmar po/ bdun pa na sha ra bha sngon po/ brgyad pa na byi bla gwa pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na chu'i lha dkar po/ gsum pa na me'i lha dmar po/

bzhi pa na rlung gi lha ljang gu/ lnga pa na zla ba'i lha dkar po/ drug pa na nyi ma'i lha dmar po/ bdun pa na gshin rje sngon po/ brgyad pa na nor 'dzin ser po/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyangs pa'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa// sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug pa// dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung*// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi// gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid// de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog sngon mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga (281)dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de ltar na lhag pa'i lha'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mthong ngo snyam pa'i dga' ba'i blos slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag byas par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so// oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong*// oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur// sa ma ya hoḥhoḥhoḥ/ zhes pa rnams lha dang skal pa mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos yin/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis kyi dang po la/ maṇ+ḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab// lhar bskyed byur bsal shis pa brjod// chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang*// dril bu ming dang brtul zhugs sbyin// spro na sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin// zhes pa ltar las/

dang po rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes pas gsol ba btab ste/ sngon 'gro byur bsal ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis mdzes pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed mda' yab pu shu la sogs (282)pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ de'i g.yas g.yon du sbyang ba'i yo byad rnams dang*/ steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun tu dung dang*/ 'phan dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ de nyid la chu bzhis sbyang ba byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ oṃ ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐/

zhes pas sbyangs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sdig pa'i sa bon kaṃ yig gi rnam pas sna sgor thon nas mdun gyi til la thim/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas he ru ka zhig bye ba las kyi rdo rje dang tha mi dad par gyur nas khyed rang rnams kyi sdig sgrib kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i til de g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ g.yon du chos nyid kyi rgya mtshor dor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya/ badz+ra sa twa s+ya/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na swā hā/ zhes dang chus kyang sbyangs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa/ rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi byur dang skal pa ngan pa dang*/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig /ces pas byur bsal nas/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa thogs nas bkra shis kyi cho ga byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ phun sum tshogs 'dzin gser gyi ri bo lta bu'i mdog /'jig rten gsum mgon dri ma gsum (283)ni rab tu spangs// sangs rgyas chu skyes 'dab rgyas lta bu'i spyan mnga' ba// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// dam chos rab mchog skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// 'jig rten bkra shis gnyis pa deng 'dir khyod la shog /dam pa'i chos dang ldan zhing thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /dge 'dun lha dang lha ma yin dang mis mchod pa// ngo tsha dpal gnas tshogs kyi nang na rab kyi mchog /'jig rten bkra shis gsum pa deng 'dir khyod la shog /dga' ldan lha yi gzhal med khang ni snying por bcas// 'gro la phan phyir 'dir gshegs dbang por bcas pa'i lha// rjes su 'brang ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog

/'dab gsar 'tsher ba'i me tog char 'bab lum+bī'i tshal// mang po lha yis bsten par mgon po bltams pa na// srid pa'i mthar gyur pa yi bkra shis gang lags pa// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /sna tshogs skyon rnams rnam par gzhom par bya ba'i phyir// dges bas dka' thub tshal du nam phyed mngon par byung*// dbang bcas lha rnams rjes su 'brang ba'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /chu bo'i 'gram du mchod yon phreng bas yongs su bskor// zhi phyir ngo mtshar gyur pa srid pa dag byed pa// klu yi rgyal pos legs par bstod pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /grong khyer mchog gyur ser skya zhes ni bya ba der// rmad du grags pa chen po'i lha yis mngon bstod pa// bsam yas dge sgrub de bzhin (284)gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /sems can thams cad la ni phan phyir byang chub pa// dam chos rin chen tshogs ni thub pa las byung ba// sems can don bsgrub rab rgyas brtson pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /rab tu 'od 'bar gser mdog lta bu'i sku mnga' ba// bai ḍūr+ya mdog lta bu'i rtsa gdan steng du bzhugs// skyil krung legs bcas mi g.yo sku mnga'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /shing gi rgyal po'i rtsa bar bcom ldan byams stobs kyis// bdud tshogs kun las rnam par rgyal tshe sa dang mkhar// rnam pa sna tshogs ngo mtshar gyur pa'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /wā ra ṇā sir bzhugs nas bde bar gshegs ston pas// sa dang mkha' la ngo mtshar shin tu gsal byung ba// chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor ba'i bkra shis gang*// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog

/bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa mchod phyir thogs// bsod nams bya byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa// bcom ldan thub pa shākya seng ges gang gsungs pa'i// bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi spang pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig /de rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga rnams grub nas/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la 'di ltar nges par bya ste/ don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin 'od gsal chen pos skye 'gro thams cad la khyab par bzhugs na'ang*/ kun rdzob bag chags 'khrul pa'i dbang gis nga dang nga yir bzung (285)ba la brten nas byung ba'i phung khams skye mched du snang ba ma 'gags kyi bar du sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la longs spyod pas 'khor 'das kyi gzhi sems nyid kun tu sbyang bar bya dgos shing*/ de sbyangs pas phyi rol phung sogs kyi chos ltar snang ba rnams rang gi ngang gis lhag pa'i lhar 'gyur te/ rang sems dag ma dag tu snang ba las gzhan pa'i rang la 'khor 'das 'ching grol du snang ba med pas so// des na sems nyid rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa don gyi sdom par nges pa'i shes pa brtan po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dbang don dag bya dag byed ngo 'phrod pa gal che ste/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ dbang bskur chos sgo tsam ma yin// gsang sngags rten 'brel lam byed pas// rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'i gdams ngag yin// phung po khams dang skye mched la// sangs rgyas sa bon btab nas ni// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas byed pa yi// thabs la dbang bskur zhes su btags// zhes 'tshang rgya ba'i phyi nang gi rten 'brel thams cad dbang bzhi sgo nas sgrigs dgos par gsungs shing*/ de yang sbyang gzhi rang bzhin gyis dag pa la dag par shes pa'i shes rab dang ldan pa'i sgo nas kun rdzob tu ma dag par snang ba rnams lha so so'i dag pas sbyang dgos la/

des grol bar 'gyur ram zhe na/ rang sems 'khrul pa'i ngo bor ma dag par snang ba de nyid sngags kyis sbyangs te rang rig pa'i ye shes su shes par byas nas lhar bsgom pas grol te/ rang bzhin kyis dag pa'i phyir sbyong du rung zhing glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa'i phyir sbyang dgos la/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi cha de glo bur dri bral du zhen nas zhugs pas zhen pas 'jug cing 'brel bas mi bslu ba'i phyir thabs des grol bar 'gyur te/ de'ang sbyongs gzhi rags pa phung khams skye (286)mched du snang ba'i chos sum cu rtsa gnyis/ sbyang bya de rnams la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog rags pa sum cu rtsa gnyis/ sbyong byed gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha sum cu rtsa gnyis/ sbyong tshul sbyong gzhi'i chos su snang ba de sbyong byed lha'am ye shes su kha dog bsgyur te bsgoms pas sbyangs 'bras gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha sum cu rtsa gnyis su 'gyur ba yin/ de la gdan gsum gyi 'gro ldog shes dgos pas gdan gsum ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang gshegs ma'i gdan/ byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma'i gdan/ khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan rnams te gsum yin la/ de yang 'og tu spyan 'dren par 'gyur ba'i nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la gdan gsum dngos su tshang*/ mdun bskyed slob dpon dang dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa dang*/ bskyed 'gyur rnams la gdan gsum rnam dag gi sgo nas tshang*/ de bzhi ka'ang slob ma'i phung khams skye mched gdan gsum tshang bar byin gyis rlob pa'i cha nas gdan gsum phrin las kyi sgo nas tshang zhing*/ slob ma lhar bskyed par 'gyur pa la gdan gsum rnam dag gi tshul gyis tshang bar shes shing sgom pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas dbang len dgos pas 'di rnams la go brnyed pa gal che/ cho ga dngos la rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rten la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dbang bskur ba dang*/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rten la sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlob pa'i dbang gnyis kyi dang po la rig pa'i dbang lnga po re re'ang 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa bzhis byin gyis brlab pa'am/

yang na mi bskyod pa la 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa bzhis byin gyis brlabs nas cod paṇa gyi dbang man la slob ma dang dbang rdzas kyi dmigs pa 'pho zhing*/ slob dpon mi bskyod pa'i rnal 'byor kho nas kyang (287)rung bar bzhed la/ phyag len phal cher 'di la mdzad pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho ྅ haṃ/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu rdo rje slob dpon dang bcas pa mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gsum ka'ang mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na glang po che rta bong bu glang rnga mo mi shar bha byi bla/ g.yon pa rnams na sa'i lha chu'i lha me'i lha rlung gi lha zla ba'i lha nyi ma'i lha gshin rje nor sbyin rnams 'dzin pa/ spyi bor rdo rje nag pos mtshan pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slob dpon la thim slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/

yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug /khro bo bcu dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ (288)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag dang dbang rdzas la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rīr bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing slob dpon dang dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ khyed rang rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrub pa'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig tu mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin can gyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa gdan gsum tshang ba re thogs te khyed rang rnams mi bskyod par gsal ba'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang gsang ba'i dbang thob/

snying ga yan chad gang shes (289)rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wid+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod nas/ de ltar na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag /rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// 'og ma rnams la slob dpon lhar bskyed pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs pa dor nas lha dang dbang rdzas go bsgyur ba ma gtogs cho ga'i 'gros 'di nyid sbyar bar bya ba yin pas/ rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ swa bhā wa sogs/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du āṃ las rin po che ā+oṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan kyai rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na bya ka ran+da/ ngur pa/ lug /bye'u tsa ko ra/ bye khra/ hor khra/ 'ol ba/ nya khra/ g.yon pa rnams na stobs kyi rgyu/ dung skyong*/ rigs ldan/ pad+ma/ pad+ma chen po/ 'jog po/ nor rgyas/ mtha' yas rnams 'dzin pa/ spyi bor rin po che ser po zur brgyad pas mtshan pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis (290)ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu

sogs nas/ thugs ka'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang rdzas la rnam rgyal bum chu 'thor ba thog ma kun la 'gre/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ khyed rang rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrub pa'i slad du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gyi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin can gyi cod pan gdan gsum tshang ba re thogs nas khyed rang rnams rin chen 'byung ldan du gsal ba'i spyi bor bcings nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa'i// rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra rā ga ta badz+ra sha li hoḥ de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag tu bum pa'i chus kyang spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzad/

rnam rgyal bum chu spyi bor 'thor ba 'og ma kun la 'gre/ oṃ badz+rī (291)bha wa ābhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas nai wid+ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa mchod nas/ de ltar rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag /tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ swa bhā wa sogs/ khyed rang rnams kyi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang 'od dpag med kyai rdo rje sku mdog dmar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na dom/ bya rgod/ bse/ ba men/ stag /spre'u/ chu srin na kra/ ce spyang*/ g.yon pa rnams na khwa/ 'ug pa/ bya dkar/ ne tso/ seng ge /sa ra sa/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ri/ phag rnams 'dzin pa/ spyi bor pad+ma dmar pos mtshan pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu sogs nas/ thugs ka'i dz+rīṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od dpag med kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ(292)dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/

oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ khyed rang rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrub pa'i slad du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang slob dpon lhan cig pas 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin can gyi rdo rje gdan gsum tshang ba de thogs te khyed rang rnams 'od dpag med du gsal ba'i phyag g.yas su byin nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod// sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyed la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs// oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes pas lag g.yas su rdo rje sbyin/ de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag tu bum pa'i chus kyang spyi bor dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa ni/ puṣ+pe sogs/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes kyi phung po (293)gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ swa bhā wa sogs/ khyed rang rnams kyi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa kyai rdo rje sku mdog ljang gu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na gza' lhag pa/ phur bu/ 'jug rings/ sgra gcan/ mig dmar/ pa sangs/ spen pa/ khyab 'jug /g.yon pa rnams na dbang po/ tshangs pa/ drag po/ bdud sdig can/ khyab 'jug gi bu mo gshol mda' 'dzin/ lha rgyal ba dam pa/ thag zangs ris/ lha ma yin stobs ldan rnams 'dzin pa/ spyi bor ral gri dkar pos mtshan pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i khaṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad don yod grub pa kyai rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las don (294)yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ khyed rang rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrub pa'i slad du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang slob dpon lhan cig pas don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin can gyi dril bu gdan gsum tshang ba re khyed rang rnams don yod grub par gsal ba'i phyag g.yon du byin nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/
