oṃ badz+rī a dhi pa ti stāṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma s+t+waṃ zhes pas dril bu lag pa g.yon du sbyin/ de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag tu bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa ni/ puṣ+pe sogs/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag /'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ swa bhā wa sogs/ khyed rang rnams kyi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje sku mdog (295)dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na rma bya/ ma he/ chu srin ma ka ra/ nya ro hi ta/ rus sbal/ 'og gi klu/ ngang skya/ ri bong*/ g.yon pa rnams na sbal ba thu'u/ sprin shugs/ sbrul ha la/ rtsangs pa nag po/ byi ba/ g.yag /gla ba/ bya bzhad rnams 'dzin pa/ spyi bor 'khor lo dkar pos mtshan pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i bh+rūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kyi rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas khyed rang rnams la thim/ 'dir dbang rdzas lhar bsgrub pa med pas khyed rnams yan lag bzhi par bsgrub pa'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas rnam snang gi rang bzhin can gyi ming gdan gsum tshang ba re me tog gang las phog pa'i lha las drangs te btags pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta kye zhes dri/ gsang mtshan med na gsar du btags te/ de yang skyes pa la/ bzhad pa'i rdo rje sgeg pa'i rdo rje dang*// rol pa'i rdo rje a la la rdo rje// shin tu dga' ba'i myu gu'i rdo rje dang*// zhe sdang rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// rnam snang chen po'i rdo rje kyai rdo rje// zhes sogs dang*/ bud med la/ rdo rje snyems ma rdo rje mtshon cha (296)ma// rdo rje bdag med e ma ho bde ma// rdo rje sgeg ma la sogs gang rigs gdags// de nyid brtan pa'i yan lag tu bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ de la nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa ni/ puṣ+pe sogs/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag /gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos dbyings ye shes mngon du byas// rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// dbang de rnams kyi don ni/ dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba// gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha// chos rnams rang bzhin rnyogs med dag /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis// zhes gsungs te/ de'ang dngos po te chos can gyi snang ba gang dang gang snang ba ni gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha yin la/ lha de'ang glo bur du byas pas ma yin gyi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnyog pa dang bral ba'i phyir gdod ma nas lhar rnam par dag cing glo bur gyi dri ma rnams cho ga 'dis bsal bar byed pas/

deng phyin chad de dag la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog thams cad spangs nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes su lta bar gyis shig /de dag gis ni ma rig pa la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa lnga rig pa ye shes lngar sgyur bar byed pas rig pa'i dbang ngam/ rig ma spyan ma la sogs pa'i thabs rig pa yab lnga'i las yin pas rig pa'i dbang zhes bya ba yin/ de rnams kyis chos can gyi snang ba thams (297)cad lhar byin gyis brlabs nas de dag gi chos nyid drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' ngo sprod de sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlob par byed pa brtul zhugs kyi dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ swa bhā wa sogs/ khyed rang rnams kyi phung po lnga'i chos nyid la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa// zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na glang po che/ rta/ bong bu/ glang*/ rnga mong*/ mi/ sha ra bha/ byi la/ g.yon pa rnams na sa'i lha/ chu'i lha/ me'i lha/ rlung gi lha/ zla ba'i lha/ nyi ma'i lha/ gshin rje/ nor sbyin rnams 'dzin pa/ spyi bor rdo rje nag pos mtshan pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la thim/ slob dpon gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ de nyid la hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i lte bar rdo rje sems (298)dpa' yab yum/ steng gi rwa lnga la rnam snang la sogs pa'i rigs lnga/ de'i 'og gi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'i byang sems brgyad/ 'og gi rwa lnga la ye shes mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma lnga/ de'i 'og gi pad 'dab brgyad la lcags kyu ma la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad de lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yas par brtul zhugs kyi dbang gi slad du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa twaṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra sa twa hīḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sgo nas byin pa'i rdo rje de gsol te snying gar bzung ste/ deng phyin chad tha mal pa'i spyod pa thul la/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin la zhugs par gyis shig /de ltar na rig pa'i dbang lnga thob pas bya spyod kyi chu cod pan rdo rje dril bu ming ste lnga las/ thob byed kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i rigs lnga'i sdom pa thob pas bya spyod kyi rgyud 'chad pa dang nyan pa la dbang ba'i dbang thob cing*/ de'i steng du tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum brtul nas rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs su byin gyis rlob par byed pa brtul zhugs kyi dbang thob pas rnal 'byor rgyud kyi slob ma'i dbang las thob byed kyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i bla med kyi rdo rje slob ma'i dbang thob pas rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang bar byas shing rnal 'byor gyi rgyud 'chad pa la mi dbang yang nyan pa la dbang ba dang rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud nas bshad pa'i las tshogs dang dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang ba yin no// de bas na khyed rnams me tog gang la phog (299)pa'i lha'i bsgom bzlas la brtson par gyis shig

/des sangs rgyas thams cad bzlas pas mnyes par 'gyur bas khyed rnams kyi dman pa dang 'bring gi dngos grub gang 'dod pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhes bsgoms la spro na/ rtsa sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin no// de ltar thun mong gi dbang drug gis khyed rang rnams kyi rags pa phung khams skye mched de bzhin nyid dang bcas pa lhar byin gyis brlabs nas phra ba dkyil 'khor bzhi sku bzhir byin gyis rlob bar byed pa thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang bzhi'i dang po phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i dbang la/ yon phul gsol gdab dbang stegs bzhag /dam tshig gsum sbyin chu dbang bskur// rab gnas mchod dang rnam bzhag bstan// sgeg sogs mig thur me long dang*// dril bu mda' gzhu yang me long*// chos bshad sprul bshad rtogs pa bskyed// ces pa ltar las/ dang po phyir mi ldog pa slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba// mgon pos bdag la stsal nas kyang*// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon phrin las yongs su gsungs// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa'ang bla na med pa stsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/

slob ma dbang stegs kyi steng du bzhag /de med na khyed rang rnams gong du bshad pa'i dbang stegs kyi steng du lhar bskyed ma thag pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis 'khod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun tu dung dang*/ 'phan dang me tog gi phreng ba la sogs pa'i (300)mchod pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nyid la dam tshig gsum rim gyis sbyin dgos pa las/ thog mar rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi slad du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje bshad ma thag pa'i lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin can de khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yas su byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa twaṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra sa twa hrī: hi hi hi hi hūm̐ zhes pas sbyin pa'i rdo rje de gsor te snying gar 'gying ba dang bcas pas bzung nas rdo rje'i de kho na nyid la thugs gtod par zhu/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje sems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o// oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ kyai rdo rje 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rig stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa yin la/ rang gi sems thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nges don gyi rdo rje yin no snyam du mos pa mdzod/ dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gi slad du a las byung ba'i dril bu mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum pa'i nang du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma yab dang bcas pa/

steng gi rwa lnga la rigs lnga/ rwa'i 'og gi pad 'dab brgyad la byang sems brgyad khog pa'i steng gi ut+pal la sgrol ma la sogs pa brgyad dang bcas pa'i lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rang bzhin de (301)khyed rang rnams kyi phyag g.yon du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// dril bu'i sgra kun rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// ces pa'i sgo nas byin pa'i dril bu de nyid dku g.yon par kha gyen du bstan nas bzung ste/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid la thugs gtod par zhu/ aḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa// srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ/ zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ kyai dril bu 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong pa mtshon par byed pa yin la/ rang gi ngag srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ston par byed pa'i nges don gyi dril bu yin no snyam du mos pa mdzod/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gi slad du khyed rang rnams bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa/ lo grangs bcu drug lon pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'i mig sogs nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ de nyid la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi dngos gzhi byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du (302)brjod// ces dang*/

rjes su gnang ba mdor bsdus pa'i sgo nas byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// zhes brjod nas/ phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid rgyas par brjod pa ni/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba'i phyag rgyas bzung ste shes rab ma lo grangs bcu drug lon pa lta bu de dang nu ma la sogs pa phan tshun reg pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ba la brten nas byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyis lus thams cad khyab par gyur pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung*// sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir// shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs// dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyis longs// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// ci 'dod pa ni bsten bzhin du// rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// 'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i// phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su grags// yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni tha mal pa'i bde ba ni ma dag pa'o// srid pa'i sdug bsngal zad par bya ba'i phyir rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor bya ste 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la longs spyod cig /thams cad la mchod pa gyis shig /'dis rdo rje 'chang chen po kha sbyor gyi sku thob pa las mi 'da'o// de bas ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnas par gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ 'og tu mchod pa rgyas pas mchod pa ma byung gi bar du phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin de nyid las ma g.yos pa mdzod/ de nyid brtan pa'i phyir du nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod pa'i yo (303)byad sna tshogs pa dang ye shes kyi chus gang ba'i bum pa thogs te dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/

sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bas/ dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nyid la skur byed nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang slob dpon lhan cig pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rab tu gnas pa byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes pas rab tu gnas par byas te/ de nyid la mnga' dbul gyi slad du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa rgyas pas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas nai wid+ya āḥhūm̐/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbang bskur ba 'dis khyod kyi phung (304)po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched kyi dri ma thams cad dag par byas pa yin pas bde thams cad rang gi sems su 'du la sems de nyid mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' yin pas rang gi sems rnam par dag pa nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yin te/ dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa// yid kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa nyid// gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ni// sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs nyid// de yi phyi rol gru bzhi ni// mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// gang zhig byams pa la sogs sems// thig skud bzhir ni bshad pa'o// rdo rje'i thig tu gang bshad pa// chos ni rjes su dran pa'o// lta ba kun las rnam grol ba// ye shes thig tu bshad pa yin// rgyan gang yang dag bshad pa ni// tshul khrims sogs kyi sdom pa'o// dbang po lnga sogs sems gang yin// ra ba lngar ni 'byung ba nyid// gang zhig sgo zhes bshad pa ni// rnam par thar pa rnam pa bzhi// rta babs ka ba bzhi po ni// yang dag spong ba bzhi zhes brjod// dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi po ni// kha khyer bzhir ni brjod pa nyid// sgo khyud bzhi ni gang yin pa// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam pa bzhi// de bzhin me tog phreng brgyan pa// byang chub yan lag bdun po yin// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni// ka ba brgyad po zhes brjod do// lam gyi ye shes khyad par ni// rnga yab tu ni rab tu grags// gang zhig do shal bshad pa ni// nyon mongs thams cad gcod pa ste// kun tu gcod pa'i ngo bo yin// nyon mongs 'phrog pas drwa ba nyid// tshogs gnyis dag pa'i sbyor ba yis// 'khor lo bskor ba gang yin pa// nyon mongs phyed (305)ni gcod pas na// do shal phyed pa nyid du brjod// de bas na sems nyid ni byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo gzhal yas khang pa yin la/

sems la phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa du mar snang ba ni gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yin te/ de yang phung po lnga ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan/ 'byung ba bzhi ni rig ma'i gdan/ nang gi skye mched ni byang chub sems dpa'i gdan/ phyi'i skye mched ni lha mo'i gdan// nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa la sogs pa zad par byed pa ni khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan yin no// zhes pas dkyil 'khor dang lha'i rnam bzhag bstan nas/ rnam bzhag rtogs pa'i slob ma la rjes su gnang ba rnams rim pa bzhin du sgrub dgos pa las/ thog mar lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni sgeg sogs brgyad kyi phyag rgya rnams mdzad par zhu/ gar sgor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dku g.yas g.yon du bzhag ste/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas// sras dang bcas la rnam rol zhing*// rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis// dga' ston bde ba'i mchod pa gyis// āḥ de bzhin du khu tshur gnyis kha 'gram g.yas g.yon du bzhag ste/ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang*// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya// des ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur// phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no// oṃ/ khu tshur gnyis kha nas tshig 'byin pa ltar byas te/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi// glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya// de yi bde gshegs dngos grub ni// myur tu bde ba myong bar 'gyur// gī/ rdo rje thal mo spyi bor bskor ba'i gar byas te/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni// sangs rgyas (306)thams cad mchod par bya// sangs rgyas 'du ba'i phrin las kyis// gar mkhan tshul du sgyur bar gyis// hoḥ bdug spos kyi phyag rgya dang*/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos 'bul bas// brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis// lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su// ye shes kyis ni tshims par gyis// hūm̐/ me tog gi phyag rgya dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor// byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pas// mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi// bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis// bh+rūm̐

mar me'i phyag rgya dang*/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas// rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru// sems can ma rig ldongs pa la// ye shes sgron mas gsal bar gyis// pra g.yon pas dung chos 'dzin cing g.yas pas dri bzang byug pa'i tshul dang*/ rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas// tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*// rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi// byang chub lus can rnams la bsgom// ga: deng phyin chad lus kyi sgo nas sgeg pa dang*/ ngag gi sgo nas glu len pa la sogs pa spyod lam ci byed pa thams cad mi dge ba dang lung ma bstan ma yin par lha mchod pa'i bsam pas zin par gyis shig /sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang ni/ mig grur ram rdo rje la/ oṃ āṣ+ṭā na nā ya/ piṅga lor+dhā ke sha wa r+t+ma war+dha ne/ tsa turbing+sha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ḍa sha bhū dzā ya/ dzī mū ta wa pu ṣe/ ka pā la mā lā ne kā dhā ri ṇi/ a dh+yāt+ma krū ra tsit+tā ya/ daṃṣ+ṭī ṇe/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kā ra ya kā ra ya/ gardza ya/ gardza ya/ tardza ya/ tardza ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ sap+ta sā ga rā ṇa// bhan+dha bhan+dha/ nā gāṣ+ṭa kān/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sha trūn/ ha hā hi hī hu hū he he ho ho haṃ haḥphaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i rtsa sngags kyis mngon par bsngags pa'i praṃ las byung (307)ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin can gyi thur ma'am hūm̐ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rjes khyed rang rnams kyi mig gi thad kar byugs pas ma rig pa'i ling tog bsal nas sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i// ling tog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥpraṃ zhes pas sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas nas chos can gyi snang ba thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces shes pa'i slad du a las skyes pa'i me long bstan te/

chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// zhes me long dang po'i rjes gnang sbyin nas/ de ltar kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa las du mar snang yang dril bu'i sgra khog pa dang lce dang skyes bu'i rtsol ba gsum gang las byung dpyad na mi rnyed pas rang bzhin gyis stong pa ltar chos nyid skye 'gags gnas gsum gyis stong pa nam mkha'i mtshan nyid can de shes pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces shes pa'i slad du dbyangs tha ma las skyes pa'i dril bu sbyin te/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' (308)dang ni mnyam sbyor bas// kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal// zhes chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du shes par byas nas/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab dang ldan yang thabs mkhas kyi khyad par dang bral na nyan rang gi sar ltung bar 'gyur bas rang don yid la byed pa'i bsam pa bcom dgos so zhes shes pa'i slad du/ hoḥde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par byos shig ces pas/ hoḥlas skyes pa'i mda' gzhu sbyin te thabs kyi mda' drug shes rab kyi gzhu la bkang nas phyogs bzhi steng 'og gnyis te drug tu 'phangs pas rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa bcom pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par bya'o zhes gsung zhig /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i shes rab de'ang thos bsam las byung ba'i shes rab ltar don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa tsam ma yin gyi/ dbang gi ye shes rdo rje sems dpa' me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu snang la rang bzhin med pa rang gi snying la zhugs pa yin no zhes shes pa'i ched du me long rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/

oṃ badz+ra sa twa/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs// rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso// gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems ni 'di yin pas shes par gyis shig ces pa rnams sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang yin/ chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ oṃ badz+ra he tu māṃ zhes pas zhabs kyi 'og tu 'khor lo byin te sems can 'khor ba nas drongs shig ces pa'i don yin/ 'dren lugs (309)ji ltar byed na oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ zhes pas phyag g.yas su dung byin te/ dung bus la sems can 'khor du sdus shig ces pa'i don yin/ tshul ji ltar na badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ zhes pas phyag g.yon du dril bu byin te chos kyi sgra sgrogs shig ces pa'i don yin/ chos gang gis na aḥ zhes pas rgyud kyi glegs bam byin te chos 'di'i sgra sgrogs par gyis shig ces pa'i don yin pas de ltar nges pa'i sgo nas dung 'bud pa dang dril bu 'khrol ba dang glegs bam klog pa'i tshul mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa// tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga yis// skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya// rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*// khyod la rtag tu srung ba mdzad// ces pas spyir btang chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang byin nas/ chos bshad pa de'ang de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang 'brel ba'i rdo rje theg pa'i chos ston dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ rigs lnga so so'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas phyag rgya rnams kyang slob dpon la gzigs nas mdzad par zhu/
sems can kun la thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor//

zhes pa'i tshe rnam snang dang*/ de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po gsum 'dra ba las/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// zhes dang mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'khor (310)lo rab tu bskor// zhes dang rin chen 'byung ldan/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor// zhes dang 'od dpag med/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor// zhes dang don grub kyi phyag rgya byas la/ de ltar na khyod kyis sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo// rdo rje'i 'khor lo// rin chen 'khor lo// pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rnams bskor la/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs/ bshad pa gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ de ltar na bskyed pa rdul tshon nam/ ras bris gang yin skabs dang sbyar la/ dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag /dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba la dbang bar byas/ brda lnga bsdus rtse mos mnan pa/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes rtogs bskyed bya'o// gsang dbang gi sdom ni// maṇ+ḍal bstod dang gsol ba gdab// dbang bskur lung bstan rtogs pa bskyed// ces pa ltar las/ thog mar gsang dbang zhu ba'i slad du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya zhig kyang slob dpon la phul ba'i mos pa byas te bstod pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pa rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges// zhes pas bstod nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod// bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor (311)gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes gsol ba btab nas/

sngon chad kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bu'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le mu tig gi rdog ma lta bu slob dpon nyid kyi mtheb srin gyis blangs te khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gi ni// sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// zhes pas byin pa'i bdud rtsi de sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos te oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes gsung zhing myang bar zhu/ de ltar myangs pas mgrin pa na gzhir gnas kyi ya ra la wa zhes pa'i yi ge byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba dam tshig pa'i tshul du gnas pa la/ slob dpon gyis byin pa'i byang chub kyi sems gdan gsum tshang ba de nyid ye shes pa'i tshul du 'dres pas snang mched thob gsum gyi 'khor du byung ba'i rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa rags pa rnams 'gags nas stong pa dang shin tu stong pa dang*/ stong pa chen po'i nyams (312)skyes te snang ba gsum gyi rang bzhin stong pa gsum ro gcig tu gyur pa gsal zhing yangs la mi rtog pa rang byung gi ye shes stong gsal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de gsang dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de'i mtha' rten du lung bstan pa ni/ lung phal cher sprul skus ston pa/ skabs 'dir slob dpon shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal du bsgyur nas lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags bag phebs pa'i rna ba ltar 'dzin cing*/

g.yas rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas khyed rang rnams kyi gsang mtshan dang mthun pa'i de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pas mgrin gcig tu lung bstan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla rnams su bhur+bhu waḥswaḥ zhes ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no// zhes pa'i sgo nas lung bstan pas de ltar du 'gyur nges snyam pa'i dga' ba bskyed mdzod/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /dam tshig sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu bsten pa la dbang bar (313)byas/ brda mtheb srin e la rig byed gcig /lam bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes rtogs bskyed bya/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi sdom ni/ maṇ+ḍal gtod gsol rig ma gtad// dris lan sogs bya dbang dngos bskur// dbugs dbyung sbyin la rtogs pa bskyed// ces pa ltar las/ thog mar shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas bstod pa dang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ khyod ni sogs nas bdag la skyobs zhes pa'i bar gsang dbang bzhin/ zhes pas gsol ba btab nas/ sngon chad phyag rgya bha ga'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mig ras 'ching bar zhu/

dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma yid du 'ong ba lang tsho la babs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig sprul ste khyed rang rnams la gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod// dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis// zhes pa'i sgo nas byin pa'i phyag rgya des khyed rnams gsang ba'i kun du spyod pa rnams kyi snod dang mi ldan pa brtag pa'i phyir dri ba byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro'am// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed par// bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam// zhes dris pas de ltar spro zhes lan (314)btab pa'i mos pa byas nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par cis mi spro// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed par// bdag nyid ci dgar spro gyur to// zhes pas lan btab pas phyag rgya des// e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na bdag 'dug ste// sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa// pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// s+t+waṃ pad+ma bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes gsung zhing khyed rang rnams kyi pang du byon pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje dang phyag rgya bdag med mar gsal ba sprul sku lam du byed pa lha'i 'du shes/ yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la āḥs mtshan pa/

oṃ pad+ma su kha dhā ra/ ma hā rā ga su khan+da da/ tsa tu rā nan+da bha ga bi shwa /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ma ku ru ṣ+wa me/ khyed rang rnams kyi gsang ba'i gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā dwe ṣa/ tsa tu rā nan+da da ya kaḥ kha ga mu kha e/ kā ra so nā tha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kār+yam̐ ku ru ṣ+wa me zhes pas mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa longs sku lam du byed pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan skyes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos sku lam du byed pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ sku gsum lam byed 'du shes gsum dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas (315)thog mar phyag rgya'i gzugs la blta ba dang*/ sgra la mnyan pa dang*/ dri la bsnam pa dang*/ ma mchu'i sbrang rtsi myang ba dang*/ 'o dang 'khyud pa dang tsum+pa la sogs pa byas pa'i skad cig dang po la dga' ba'i ye shes/ bo la dang kak+ko la sbyar ba'i skad cig ma gnyis pa la mchog dga'i ye shes/ bsrub cing bsrub pa'i sbyor ba byas pa'i skad cig ma gsum pa la dga' bral gyi dga' ba'i ye shes/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i rang bzhin gyi rtsa btsal te snyoms par zhugs pa'i skad cig ma bzhi pa la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de dag ni phyi go rim la ltos pa'i dga' ba bzhi yin/ nang gnas la ltos pa'i dga' ba ni/ de ltar snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes chags kyi mes/ khams dwangs ma thams cad zhu nas spyi bo'i haṃ la 'dus te/ byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba'i ye shes mngon du byas/ spang bya nyon mongs pa kun btags zhi ba nyan thos kyi lam chod/ mgrin pa nas snying gar byon pas mchog dga'i ye shes mngon du byas/ spang bya nyon mongs pa lhan skyes mngon 'gyur zhi ba rang rgyal gyi lam chod/ snying ga nas lte bar byon pas dga' bral gyi ye shes mngon du byas/

spang bya nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi nas byang chub sems dpa'i lam chod/ lte ba nas gsang gnas kyi bar du byon pas thabs kyi rigs kyi bdag po'i rtse dang shes rab kyi rtsa mdzes pa'i spyi bor byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar mjal bas spang bya nyon mongs pa thams cad zhi ba brtan pa byang chub chen po'i lam chod de mdor na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyang mtshon par nus pa'i mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes zhes bya ba yin no// de yis (316)babs kyi dga' ba bzhi yin/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi bsgrub pa'i slad du byang chub kyi sems mkha' gsang gi rtse mor rlung 'pho ba med pa'i stobs kyis bzung ba de slar yi ge hūm̐ gi gdangs can gyi rlung gis drangs pas rtsa dbu ma'i lam nas gyen du byon te/ lte ba'i 'khor lo gnas brtan pa'i ming can gyi dbus su brtan pas dga' bas bsdus pa'i dga' bzhi nyams su myong*/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas/ lte ba nas snying ga'i 'khor lo thams cad yod par smra ba'i ming can gyi dbus su brtan pas mchog dgas bsdus pa'i dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong*/ rnam smin gyi 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas/ snying ga nas mgrin pa'i 'khor lo kun gyis bkur ba'i ming can gyi dbus su brtan pas dga' bral gyi dga' bas bsdus pa'i dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong*/ skyes bu byed pa'i 'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i skal pa/ mgrin pa nas spyi bo'i 'khor lo phal chen pa'i ming can gyi dbus su brtan pas lhan skyes kyis bsdus pa'i dga' ba bzhi nyams su myong*/ dri ma med pa'i 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa'i skal pa can du byas/ de'i tshe byang chub sems kyis lus thams cad la khyab/ de thams cad la bde bas khyab/ bde ba la mi rtog pas khyab/ bde stong dbyer med kyi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ces sam bsdu na lam dus bzhin ngo sprad do// de shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de'i mtha' rten du dbugs dbyung ba ni/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing*// bde gshegs (317)bka' las 'da' mi bya// spun la smad pa nyid mi bya// sems can rnams la gdug byams dang*// byang chub sems ni spang mi bya// bdag gzhan chos la smad mi bya// skal med de nyid gtam mi bya// bdag gi lus la nges mi smad// chos la yid gnyis spang bya zhing*// gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya// chos nyid tshad ni gzung mi bya// skal ldan sems can spang mi bya// dam tshig rtag tu bskyang bar bya// bud med nyid la smad mi bya// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya// rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya// rdo rje dril bu gzung bar bya// gtsug tor rtag tu bcang bar bya// rtag tu sbyin sreg dgang bar bya// rtag tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya// rtag tu bde gshegs rab gnas bya// 'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin// phyag rgya bcing ba rnam spang zhing*// mchod rten las ni mi bya ste// rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya// dkyil 'khor la sogs lus kyi las// rmi lam du yang mi bya'o// slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya// bla ma'i rgan rab phyag 'tshal lo// rtag par rgyun du sngags bzla zhing*// bsam gtan nyid kyang rnam par spyad// rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing*// rtag pa ru ni bshad pa gyis// rtag tu sems can bskyang bar bya// rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya// dzam+bha lha la chu sbyin zhing*// las rnams thams cad yang dag spyad// bye ma'i las la mchod rten yang*// mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don spang bya spong ba'i dbang du byas nas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi dang*/

bsten bya bstan pa'i dbang du byas nas las dang po pas bsgrub bya'i chos bdun dang*/ sems cung zad (318)brtan pas bslab bya rnam pa lnga dang de'i shugs kyis brtan pa cher thob nas dam tshig sdom las rnam par grol zhes pa'i tshul gyis blang dor med par spyad dgos pa rnams bstan pas na de dag ngo shes par byas nas spang blang tshul bzhin du gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung ba la thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi gsang ba'i ye shes la bslab pa ni/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi// khams gsum na ni sdig med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral bar// khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o// ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ste/ de'i don ni dad pa chen pos lha dang bla ma la chags pa/ snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don la chags pa/ shes rab chen pos chos kyi de kho na nyid la chags pa zhes bya ba 'di gsum dang bral na sdig che ba yin pas/ 'di gsum dang ma bral ba la bslab par bya'o zhes pa'i don yin/ de nas khyed rang rnams he ru ka'i nga rgyal gyis gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can re thogs te dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas pa'i rjes su gdugs logs su bzhag ste dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas lus thams cad sa la phab pa'i phyag byas pa'i mthar khyed rang rnams slob dpon gyi dkyil 'khor pa rnams la phul bar mos te dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la dbu dud tsam de mdzod/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur ba'i// slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags// zhes phul bas dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung ba'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams kun gyis (319)mthun par gsungs// sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas// dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris// khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su// sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya// khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud tshogs kun la nges rgyal te// grong khyer mchog tu bzhugs pa yin// zhes gsungs te/

de'i don ni khyed rang rnams sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag 'dzin pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen por sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis mthun par gsungs shing bu sdug pa ltar yongs su dgongs pa'i phyir/ deng phyin chad sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i sgo nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi las su bya ba rnams tshul bzhin du bsgrubs te sems can gyi don rgya chen po gyis shig /khams gsum gyi rgyal srid chen po sangs rgyas kyi grong khyer du zhugs pa dang mtshungs pa yin no// de ltar na phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag /dam tshig bud med la mi smod pa la dbang*/ brda byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no//

zhes rtogs bskyed bya/ dbang bzhi pa'i sdom ni/ maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab tshig dbang bskur// gzengs bstod rtogs bskyed la sogs bya// zhes pa ltar las/ thog mar dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar (320)maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pas// dbang bskur gsum po bdag la gnang*// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i// bzhi pa yang ni byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ sngon chad don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ de la dbang bzhi pa'i rnam grangs ni tshig gi bzhi pa/ don gyi bzhi pa/ bzhi pa rten can/ lam du byed pa'i bzhi pa/ 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i bzhi pa ste lnga las/ tshig gi bzhi pa gang la bstan pa'i yul ni/ sam bu ṭa las/ zab cing rgya che la mos na// tshig gi rin chen bzhi pa sbyin// zhes gsungs pas/ slob ma bla ma dang shes rab ye shes kyi nyams myong dang*/ zab mo'i stong pa nyid dang thabs rgya che ba'i rim par mos pa la sbyin par bya yi/ de las gzhan la ni ma yin te/ bla ma la mos pa med na bla ma'i tshig la nges pa mi skye/ dbang gi nyams myongs la mos pa med na thos bsam gyi lta ba dang khyad par med/ spros bral la mos pa med na tha mal pa'i 'dod chags dang khyad par med/ thabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mos pa med na gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i mthu med pas/ mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan zhing bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang snga ma rnams thob pa'i slob ma la dbang bzhi pa sbyin par gsungs la/ de nyid tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprad pa'i tshul ni 'di nyid kyi rtsa rgyud las/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// zhes gsungs te// de'i don ni dbang gsum pa'i gnas skabs su nyams su myong (321)ba'i ye shes 'di ni dpe dang gtan tshigs la sogs pas rtogs par dka' bas ches phra zhing mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pas mi phyed pas rdo rje/

mtha' dbus dang bral bas nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ nyon mong pa'i rdul dang bral bas rdul bral/ srid pa zad pa rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang sbyin pas na mthar phyin/ gdod ma nas ma skyes pas na zhi ba/ 'jig rten na rang gi rigs rang gis spel dgos pa ltar rang rgyud la ye shes bskyed pa'ang rang gis bsgom pa la rag las pas khyed rang yang ni de'i pha// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don nyams su blang ba'i ched du khyed rang rnams lus bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan par byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag /sems dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul gzhan thams cad bcad la/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems su nges pa'i shes pa bskyed do// sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba/ rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug gsum dbyer mi phyed pa rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sku bzhi rang chas su gnas pa de nyid/ 'bras dus kyi sku bzhi dang ngo bo dbyer med du nges shes bskyed de/ de mngon du byed pa'i thabs gzhan gyis tshig tu brjod pa la sogs pas rtogs par mi nus pas/ dpe dbang gsum pa'i ye shes kyi steng du ngo sprad de rtogs par bya ba ni/ rang nyid dbang gsum pa'i gnas skabs su lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du snang ba sprul pa'i sku dang*/ de'i sems rgyud phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rnam par shar ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ lha sku bde ba chen po'i (322)rnam par snang tsam de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad dang bral ba chos kyi sku dang*/ de gsum ldog tshul tha dad kyang rang bzhin so sor dbyer mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ mdor na sems kyi gshis cir yang ma yin pa gdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa/ rtsal sna tshogs su 'char ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed thams cad las 'das pa nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas la/

nam mkha' dang nam mkha' ro gcig pa ltar/ sems dang bde stong ro gcig pa'i ngang la 'dzin med du khong lhod kyis glod de mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ de dbang bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi yin/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'grol bar zhu/ de'i mtha' rten du gzengs bstod pa ni/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// btsud pa dang ni mthong ba yis// de ring sdig las rnam grol 'gyur// de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin// mi thub pa dang mi 'chi bas// cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ snying po bde ba chen po len cing 'dzin par byed pa'i mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir khyed rnams bcud cing mthong ba la brten nas deng phyin chad sdig pa dang sdug bsngal las grol te bde ba chen po 'bras bu'i theg pa 'dir tshud pas na lam 'di la dga' ba khyad par can dang ldan par gyis shig /de ltar byas na srid pa shin tu dag pa sku bzhi'i 'byor pa thob ste sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par 'gyur ba (323)yin na// de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum char gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /dam tshig dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang*/ brda mdzub mos nam mkha' mtshon pa/ lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes rtogs bskyed bya/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur ba yongs su rdzogs par grub pas na gnas skabs su de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig thams cad la srung sdom bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos

sogs/ zhes pas dam tshig bsdus te 'dzin par khas blangs nas dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod thams cad slob dpon la drin lan du 'bul na cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ zhes pa de rnams kyis rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal ldan bir wa pas bkral zhing rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa dpal sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyis thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba legs par gsan pas lam la 'bad pa dang dam tshig dang sdom pa srung sdom la sogs pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ zhes brjod la rjes kyi cho ga rnams bya'o// de ltar dges pa rdo rje yi// dbang bshad snying po bsdus pa 'di// sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro ba kun// rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par shog /dpal kyai rdo rje'i dbang gi cho ga snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba 'di yang don gnyer gyi slob ma mang pos bskul ba'i ngor btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis dbang bshad chen mo las mdor bsdus te dbang chu mdzes rgyan lhan thabs su (324) sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni nā tha rat+na'o// rgyas pa la mos na dbang bshad chen mo man ngag gi gter mdzod las shes par bya'o// de ltar ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i kyai rdo rje dbang gi mtshams sbyor 'di la sogs khong rigs rnams dkyus su bcug nas dbang chog ces mtshan gsol te 'jug bde bar blo gter dbang pos thar rtse rdo rje 'chang gi dgongs bzhed ltar rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi bka'i bsdu ba chen po bgyid skabs bris pa'i yi ge pa ni rgyud gzhung la dad pa thob pa dge slong shākya rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pa'o// 'dis kyang bdag sogs 'gro kun dpal dges pa rdo rje'i go 'phang la reg pa'i rgyur gyur cig
